title: Sale tracker table
description: One table on the page. Every key listed in `columns` should appear on every row.

checked.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) this table was last checked.

website.description: Full URL of the site that was checked, or null if there is none.

status.description: live = Black Friday sale is live; other_sale = a non-Black-Friday sale is on; not_yet = no sale; unknown = couldn't check; closed = no longer operating.

detected.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the Black Friday sale was first seen live. Set it the first day status becomes `live` and never change it after; null while no Black Friday sale has been seen.

notes.description: What was seen on the site.
